answer: Wax renderer brood frame warrant sealed by the mead hall turns identity into something scarce. Because each brood frame is a year of forage maps in the apiary ledger, so a farm must render a hundred real wax blocks by hand, the anchor of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the inlet first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The karst is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
